replication.target_description: RQ1 overall Mantel–Haenszel odds ratio comparing journal publication of statistically significant versus nonsignificant dissertation intervention outcomes.

n.sample_role: Treatment/intervention outcomes (analytic observations), drawn from 40 dissertation–publication pairs; not individual participants.
n.exclusions: Final pool follows exclusion of 167 dissertations lacking a corresponding publication and three during coding (one publication mismatch, one single-case design, one not an intervention). Only intervention-effect hypothesis tests extracted; pretest-equivalence, regression-assumption and correlational tests excluded. Overall model explicitly covers all 707 treatment outcomes.
n.location: p. 7, Research Question 1 and Table 2; pp. 4–5, screening and extraction

notes: Only assigned unfinished fields examined. Original side, reported_success, and unassigned replication fields are placeholders and must not overwrite previously verified fields. Source title and DOI match the supplied replication reference; publisher proof pagination used. Rendered PDF pages 7–8 inspected for layout. Overall analytic N=707 is directly printed, with 40 dissertation–publication pairs as source clusters; no summation or df inference used. The printed OR is 1.48 with 95% CI 1.10–2.00. No numeric p value/bound for this same overall OR is supplied; qualitative significance in the Discussion is not converted to a p bound. Moderator p values in Table 3 refer to different tests.
